description: Pin the rmcp-macros dependency to a specific version in the MCP workspace to ensure consistent builds and prevent potential breaking changes from upstream updates. This change should be applied to both the main workspace and the MCP sub-crate's dependency configuration.
functional_requirements: Update the rmcp-macros dependency in the MCP crate's Cargo.toml to use an exact version rather than a version range
Ensure the main workspace Cargo.toml reflects the same pinned version for consistency
Run cargo update to regenerate Cargo.lock with the locked dependency version
